status: Both original cold measurement gate files pass in full on current source. Production and original memory protocols unchanged. Broader Phase 5/6/W26 remain open.
scope: Test instrumentation and semantic observables only, no production changes.
rootCause: The former >N read minimum conflated ROW coverage with positional syscall count. The fixed fill-owned read window batches several small reads while real per-ROW normalization and measurement remain required. A zero summary or skipped unit must still fail independently of syscall batching.

contract.observable: Delegate the real RowFormatRegistration prepare/prepareAppend/measure callbacks, observe their returned facts unchanged, require exact count plus unique ordered ROW labels and independently JSON-sized LENS units for both kept/stripped variants. These text fixtures have exactly one unit per ROW; no expectation is derived from getNativeUnits.
contract.independentAggregate: Lifecycle exact serialized system/user message array; native exact complete old-converter request length from in-memory original ordinal fixture. Native length is not used to derive the oracle.
contract.warm: Zero reads, no extra measurements, identical independent length, no operation files; unsent release and append <150 bound retained.
contract.coldIO: Nonzero reads plus additional <128/<129 lifecycle and <N native upper bounds; existing cost budgets <=10N+100 and <=2N+100 unchanged. No syscall minimum is treated as semantic coverage.
contract.unchangedBehavior: Old pins, pop/owner/density, clone, compaction, reopen, captured settings, callback error identity, cancel/transport identity, #3919 descriptor cleanup.

sourceBridge.reason: All production and protocol-helper bytes match all six saved 5032-path manifests. Only three unrelated tests differ: prior equivalent large-ROW final-byte indexing and the two cold-contract tests. New observer helper is test-only, imported only by the latter two tests, not the native memory harness or its dependencies.

controlsInterpretation.skipUnit: Production omits row-1 normalized measurement while ROW callbacks still execute: per-unit LENS equality fails in both target files at original fixture sizes.
controlsInterpretation.falseZeroSummary: Real callbacks and per-unit LENS still execute but stored summary is empty: independent old-body length assertion fails, native 126 != 1676/163016. Observation counts alone cannot pass.
controlsInterpretation.staleGeneration: Removing generation validation fails existing poisoned-pin toThrow assertion.
controlsInterpretation.falseWarmUnmeasured: Accepting missingBase without validation fails existing unmeasured poisoned-pin assertion.
controlsInterpretation.wrongSettings: Ignoring format key in stored plan lookup fails existing captured-settings rejection.
controlsInterpretation.restoration: Each of five controls restores the original bytes in finally and checks SHA256; no mutated production is committed.
